title: A Pre-Registered Test of Entropy–Structure Coupling in Simulated and Observed Galaxy Clusters
abstract: Pre-registered analysis comparing the coupling between entropy-profile steepness and cool-core state in TNG-Cluster simulations versus the ACCEPT X-ray sample. Finds a strong negative correlation between density-slope-based entropy proxy and central entropy in TNG-Cluster, opposite in sign to the positive correlation reported in ACCEPT, and registers a decisive full-profile fit to resolve remaining systematics.
